parse_pdb_to_protein: parse a PDB string into an AlphaFold Protein dataclass with atom positions and residue types
parse_mmcif_to_protein: parse an mmCIF string into an AlphaFold Protein dataclass with atom positions and residue types
convert_protein_to_pdb: convert an AlphaFold Protein dataclass into a valid PDB format string with atom records
convert_protein_to_mmcif: convert an AlphaFold Protein dataclass into a valid mmCIF format string with entity and atom site tables
assemble_protein_from_prediction: assemble a Protein dataclass from AlphaFold model prediction features and structure module output
